packages.name: cockpit
packages.summary: A presentation layer that lets an agent publish rich output as a readable web page instead of a wall of chat text.
packages.problem: Long or structured agent output (reports, comparisons, diagnoses, decision lists) is hard to scan and impossible to find again when it lives in a chat.

packages.name: exploring-first
packages.summary: Separate gathering information from drawing conclusions by delegating the gathering to a subagent.
packages.problem: An agent trained to answer completely mixes research and conclusion in one response, which produces premature conclusions.
triggers: three or more tool calls expected
